shortDefinition: Instructions given to an AI model before the conversation starts that set its behavior and persona.
fullDefinition: A system prompt is a set of instructions provided to an LLM at the start of a session (before any user messages) that defines how the model should behave. It can set a persona ('You are a helpful legal assistant'), restrict topics, define output format, provide background context, or encode specific rules. Many AI products are built primarily through carefully engineered system prompts.
examples: Custom GPTs in ChatGPT are built with a custom system prompt
Claude Projects use system prompts to define the assistant behavior
